answer: Cross-sign the claim, hold it in escrow until finality, draw auditors from a rotating pool. Edge cases: a rotated operator voids pending signatures, a reorg burns the escrow, a silent auditor is replaced instead of awaited. On a tundra of new accounts the glacier move is signing early and cheap, and the lagoon is calm only after escrow settles; a farm has to keep every signature alive through finality before it earns.
